caption: The drawing depicts a single hand broom centered on a plain, off-white background. The broom has a bristle portion composed of yellowish-brown straw. The straw is gathered and held together near the top and middle by two narrow, dark brown horizontal bands. The handle of the broom is elongated, primarily red in color with lighter streaks suggesting a wood grain pattern. At the very top of the handle, there is a looped cord or string, also brown, attached to the end for hanging. The composition is simple, with the broom vertically oriented and occupying the central area of the image space. There are no additional objects or background details present.
title: Broom
